questions.question: What are the four distinct challenges of an effective defense according to the book?
options: A) Securing the infrastructure, devices, local networks, and the perimeter
B) Securing data, applications, endpoints, and cloud
C) Securing passwords, firewalls, antivirus, and backups
D) Securing people, processes, technology, and compliance
questions.answer: A) Securing the infrastructure, devices, local networks, and the perimeter
